newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's MIBANK pays 15 pound div for 96.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's MIBANK pays 15 pound div for 96.

text.p: Misr International Bank/MIBANK will distribute from June 22 a dividend of 15 pounds ($4.42) a share for the financial year 1996 and will issue one free share for every four with the dividend, brokers said on Sunday.
The bank gave out a 10-pound dividend for 1995.
The bank made a net profit after unusual items of 141.2 million pounds in 1996, against 95.6 million in 1995.
A general assembly held in Cairo on Saturday also approved a proposal to denominate all shares in the bank in Egyptian pounds instead of U.S. dollars, the brokers said.

Under the new structure, the issued capital will be 112.5 million pounds, divided into 22.5 million shares with a nominal value of five pounds each. Under the present structure there are 18.75 million shares with a nominal value of $5.
Analyst Mahmoud Soheim of Prime Investments said the increase in the dividend should increase demand for MIBank shares in the coming days. But the shares closed 6.00 pounds down on Sunday at 603.00.
